what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2350 Ethiopian refugees in Sweden, 1.4% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia from 1985 to 1991 and from 2020 to 2022.
It also records armed conflicts over Oromiya and Ogaden territory in periods from 1985 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 7076 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 8600, at the end of 1992.
It fell to a low in 2007 and rose again; the main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1998.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
